action.instructions: In this turn-based party RPG battle, which single action should the active character take?

criteria.attack: Attack a single enemy, especially to finish a weakened one, when the party is healthy.
criteria.aoe_skill: Use an area skill that hits all enemies when several enemies are present and mana allows.
criteria.heal: Heal an ally whose health is low enough to be at risk of falling this round.
criteria.guard: Guard to reduce incoming damage when the character is the likely target of a big attack.
criteria.use_item: Use an item to revive a fallen ally or cure a crippling status when no skill can.

danger.instructions: How likely is the party to lose a member this round?
